items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Well, that's Bunk, you know, his fellow here, Bunk Johnson and Billy Marrera, and Louis Nelson, myself, Buddy Johnson.

ctx.x: Yeah, sure. Yeah. How about your two brothers? Did they start playing after you or before you? After me, yeah. After you. Uh-huh. What was the first band you started playing with?

Well, the first band I started was, let's see, the Superior, I think, was the first band. And then I played with Papa Celestine, you know, different fellows. Remember who was in the Superior? Well, that's Bunk, you know, his fellow here, Bunk Johnson and Billy Marrera, and Louis Nelson, myself, Buddy Johnson.
